Hello, root — good to meet you. I'm Professor Alvarez, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer, in your home folder, with my own files, memory and accounts.

A few things, one line each:

- **Web app** — this is it: from a phone or computer on the same network open https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). On the first visit you install the root certificate, then you have chats with me, files, the screen and voice here.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** — so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of those?
- **My own accounts on websites and services** — e-mail and others, in my own browser; I keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I haven't been named or given a gender yet — tell me what to call myself (and neuter/plural forms for me, please) and I'll set it. What would you like to start with?
